Title: Karan's Day

Cast

1. Karan - 32 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Sonali - 25 years, princess, daughter
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
3. Kavita - 65 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
4. Suresh - 60 years, king, father
Look: golden crown, red royal robe

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons
2. The village well - a stone well, a rope and a bucket
3. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Karan stands on the training ground. Sonali, Suresh and Kavita stand near him.]

Kavita: "What lovely weather!"

[Karan mounts his horse and gallops away.]

Karan: "That's easy."

[Karan shoots an arrow from his galloping horse.]

Suresh (softly): "That's easy."

[Sonali rides into the training ground on her horse.]

Sonali: "That's great!"

Scene 2: The village well - Day

Kavita: "What a nice place."

[Karan drinks water from his cupped hands.]

Kavita: "Yes, all right."

[Karan splashes water on his face at the well.]

Kavita (happily): "Okay, Karan."

Scene 3: The bathroom - Day

[Karan stands in the bathroom. Sonali and Suresh stand near him.]

Karan: "What a nice place."

[Karan shaves in front of the mirror.]

Karan (excited): "That was such a fun day!"
